# Offsite Exhibitions 2025 – 2026

# **Offsite Exhibitions 2025 – 2026**

The Barber is closed to the public as we undergo a major [transformation project](https://barber.org.uk/reimagining-our-space/). A selection of our world-class collections will be on display at partner galleries in the UK giving you the chance to experience these works in exciting new contexts.

---

## **The Barber in London: Highlights from a Remarkable Collection**

Photo: David Bebber

**23 May 2025 – 31 August 2026**

The Courtauld, London

Katja and Nicolai Tangen 20th Century Gallery, Floor 3

Included in Gallery Entry

[Find out more](https://courtauld.ac.uk/whats-on/exh-the-barber-in-london-highlights-from-a-remarkable-collection/)

---

## **Modern Masterpieces: Paintings from the Barber Institute of Fine Arts**

Installation View, Modern Masterpieces at Compton Verney, 2025. 
© Jamie Woodley and Compton Verney

**12 November 2025 – 1 November 2026**

Compton Verney, Warwickshire

Included in admission fee

[Find out more](https://www.comptonverney.org.uk/whats-on/modern-masterpieces/)

---

## **Inventing Post-Impressionism: works from the Barber Institute of Fine Arts**

Photo by Lee Robbins

**8 March – 2 November 2025**

Charleston in Firle

£11 | Concessions available

This exhibition has ended.

[Find out more](https://www.charleston.org.uk/exhibition/inventing-post-impressionism-works-from-the-barber-institute-of-fine-arts/)

@graph.description: Monet, Manet, and Magritte; Renoir, Rubens, Rossetti and Rodin; Degas and Delacroix -- not to mention Picasso, Botticelli, Turner and Gainsborough... You can see major works by all these great artists in the Barber Institute of Fine Arts, at the University of Birmingham. There’s also a stunning coin gallery and an exciting programme of exhibitions, concerts, lectures, and family events.
